title: $25.99 for All-You-Can-Eat Korean BBQ @ Jin Korean BBQ 고기구이 (Houston, TX)
description:
We came here to check out the hype and it was worth it. For $25.99/person you can get unlimited amount of marinated short rib   (LA Galbi), marinated prime ribeye, squid, bulgogi along with all the banchan , kimchi fried rice,  japchae and soup. Just make sure you don't waste any food because there is a $20 charge. If you do come on the weekend, expect a mininum 2 hours wait unless you get there around 4:30pm. Everything was good and delicious .
